BiblicalUsage: Gazam is the palmerworm, the first of the four locusts that eat the land bare. That which the palmerworm has left the locust has eaten, says Joel 1:4, and the palmerworm devoured the gardens and vineyards in Amos 4:9. But God promises to restore the years that the locust has eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmerworm, in Joel 2:25.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the palmerworm is the first bite of judgment, and the promise of Joel is the last word. The years the locust ate are not lost to God, and I hold that He restores what the devourer has taken.
